send_message: send a text message or file attachment to a recipient by their user ID
create_group_conversation: create a new group conversation with at least two participants and an optional title
read_conversation: read messages from a conversation with pagination offset, limit, and optional date range filters
search_conversations: search conversations by query string across participants, titles, and message content with date filters
download_attachment: download a file attachment from a specific message in a conversation to a local path
